quality_notes: No effect survived correction for multiple testing (small sample; only detectable at Cohen's f>0.1). Contrasts with Tyrka 2015 and Klengel 2013, which found significant hypomethylation at intron 7 associated with maltreatment - here the main effect at intron 7 was not significant (only nominal PHQ-9 x genotype interaction in that region). Negative/mixed finding relevant to the project's consistency analysis.

intervention_detail: retrospective self-report of childhood physical abuse, high frequency (score >=3) vs no childhood abuse
quality_notes: Novel CpG island shore site downstream of NR3C1 exon 1F promoter - NOT the canonical exon 1F CpG island most other studies target; direct comparison across studies should account for this. Effect_size = beta (% methylation difference vs no-abuse referent); p_value is the p-trend across low/intermediate/high abuse frequency categories (dose-response confirmed). Adjusted for age and parental education. Cohort: African-American women only (Black Women's Health Study) - homogeneous sex/ethnicity sample. Emotional support in childhood attenuated association only in highest-severity subgroups but numbers were very small (inconclusive).

Effect_size not reported as a single beta in the group comparison (Mann-Whitney U on % methylation); see quality notes.
